title: TuCo: Measuring the Contribution of Fine-Tuning to Individual Responses of LLMs
findings: The study found that the alignment of large language models with specific religious beliefs can be controlled by scaling the magnitude of their fine-tuning component (FTC). For example, increasing the FTC by 25% on Llama2 13B led to a 24% increase in its alignment with Christian beliefs, indicating that these beliefs are strongly represented in its fine-tuning dataset.
